paragraphs.text: A bakery in the old quarter has never placed an advertisement. It sells one kind of bread, baked twice a day, and usually sells out by four in the afternoon. Customers often queue along the street.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: The owner has refused several offers to open branches, saying that the oven and the water of this district cannot be copied. Her daughter, who trained as an engineer, now works in the bakery.
paragraphs.label: B

items.prompt: The bakery sells several kinds of bread.
Bread is usually still available in the evening.
The owner turned down chances to expand.
The daughter will take over the bakery.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–4. Do the following statements agree with the information in the text? Write TRUE, FALSE or NOT GIVEN.
